Simplify MCP approvals reviewer routing (#25819)

turn config
- remove the MCP-side approvals reviewer policy object and per-turn
policy syncing
- keep direct MCP calls and MCP elicitations on the same
reviewer-resolution path

- `just fmt`

- `just fix -p codex-mcp`
- `just test -p codex-mcp`
